title: Defect-syndrome cellular automaton repair seeded by the 64-modular order-668 frontier object
novelty_claim: Use cellular automata as a sparse defect-transport and repair dynamic on the actual order-668 frontier seed, rather than as a direct Hadamard construction or another full-matrix energy minimizer.
closest_prior_art: Quantum / annealing formulations of Hadamard search
differentiation: State lives on the residual Gram-defect support or a compressed update packet representation, not on a raw 668 x 668 sign lattice.
Search starts from the best known near-solution for order 668 instead of a random start.
The contribution is framed narrowly as an exact-search repair heuristic for the open real order-668 case, not as a general CA construction method for Hadamard matrices.
easiest_falsifier: From the same 64-modular seed and the same compressed representation, matched greedy, tabu, or simulated annealing repair removes defects as fast or faster, or the defect support quickly plateaus/diffuses instead of annihilating.
evidence_plan: Acquire and canonicalize the cited 64-modular order-668 seed or generating quadruple.
Define one compressed defect representation and one seed-matched non-CA control in the same coordinates.
Benchmark exact hits, defect collapse, and restart statistics against greedy, tabu, and simulated annealing on solved smaller controls before the order-668 seed.
Stop immediately if the CA only improves approximate metrics without an exact-feasibility advantage.
budget_envelope: One frontier seed family, one representation, four matched baselines.
No broad family sweep and no random-start full-matrix CA until the seeded kill test survives.

title: Lag-space cellular automaton on four relaxed 167-channels
novelty_claim: Use autocorrelation-residue cells as the CA state variable for the prime-core 167 bottleneck, instead of searching the raw matrix or reusing a fixed Williamson/Turyn family as-is.
closest_prior_art: Cocyclic and compressed order-4p Hadamard search
differentiation: The intended state is the lag-defect field itself, not a classical fully structured sequence family.
The method is only viable if it can stay in a smaller-than-matrix coordinate system without collapsing into standard circulant or cocyclic syntax.
Novelty comes from representation-level locality, not from relabeling a known structured-family optimizer.
easiest_falsifier: Every successful or near-successful trajectory canonicalizes to an already-studied structured family, or each update still requires global autocorrelation recomputation, which collapses the CA claim.
evidence_plan: Use the backup only if H1 fails for principled locality reasons rather than simple underperformance.
Compare CA and non-CA local search in exactly the same lag-space coordinates.
Audit family leakage explicitly against Williamson, Turyn, Goethals-Seidel, cocyclic, and block-circulant structure.
Keep exact reconstruction and exact-hit rate as the acceptance gate.
budget_envelope: One lag-space representation and one matched non-CA control.
Hard stop if novelty collapses into optimizer-over-known-family.

title: Generative spacetime cellular automaton for row emission
novelty_claim: Search over a compact local rule and seed whose spacetime orbit emits candidate rows, compressing the variable space below the explicit 668 x 668 matrix.
closest_prior_art: Linear bipermutive CA constructions touching Hadamard-adjacent objects
Compact rule-table generative search in cellular automata
differentiation: Targets the irregular prime-core 167 frontier instead of the power-of-two or prime-power regimes where prior CA constructions are strongest.
Must be judged against the known 64-modular defect profile rather than against toy constructive examples.
This is a reserve branch because it is more novel conceptually but less anchored to the current order-668 frontier artifact.
easiest_falsifier: Radius-1 or radius-2 rule families only produce short-period, linear, or power-of-two-like behavior and cannot approximate the qualitative defect profile of the current 64-modular order-668 seed.
evidence_plan: Do not activate unless both H1 and H2 fail for representation reasons.
Test whether a compact rule family can even mimic frontier defect statistics on reduced controls before any exact-search claim.
Reject immediately if the branch falls back into prior CA construction regimes or brute-force rule sweeps.
budget_envelope: Very tight exploratory budget after champion and backup fail.
No wide rule enumeration and no brute-force Wolfram-style search.
